headline: PSD argues that the 2027 budget must be adopted only after reorganising state institutions and companies
summary: The PSD group in the Senate argues the 2027 budget should be built only after reorganising state institutions and companies. It wants the budget adopted by about 15 December.
why: The annual state budget sets spending and tax policy, which drive Romania's deficit and sovereign financing needs. Investors track budget timing and fiscal consolidation closely.
